change.after:
type Feature interface {
	Name() string
	Discover(cfg *NodeConfiguration) bool
	InferForScheduling(podInfo *PodInfo) bool
	InferForUpdate(oldPodInfo, newPodInfo *PodInfo) bool
	MaxVersion() *version.Version
	IsVersionGated() bool
}
change.description: A new method IsVersionGated() bool is added to the Feature interface. All concrete types that implement Feature must now also implement IsVersionGated. This breaks the explicit compile-time interface checks in each implementor file and the []Feature slice assignment in registry.go.

breaking_patterns.why_breaks: Explicit compile-time interface satisfaction checks fail because the concrete struct does not implement the new IsVersionGated() bool method required by the Feature interface.
Assigning concrete Feature values into a []nodedeclaredfeatures.Feature slice fails to compile when the concrete types no longer satisfy the expanded interface.
